basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Redditor from Southern California, I've been navigating the depths of Reddit for nearly a decade. I have a background in digital marketing and work from home, which allows me the flexibility to explore my interests in indie films and gaming. On the weekends, you can find me hiking the trails around Chicago, where I recently relocated. I'm single, which gives me the freedom to dive headfirst into my hobbies. Typically, I'm online during the late evenings, catching up on the latest subreddit drama and sharing my thoughts on obscure movies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in marketing and have spent the last decade building my expertise in digital strategies. My love for cinema and gaming has led me to self-teach a lot about film theory and game design. I enjoy sharing this knowledge on subreddits related to my interests.
